title: Choose the visual world for Post maker
question: The roll assigned Side A mixtape. Keep it, take an alternate, or re-roll.

options.label: Side A mixtape
options.thesis: Today's best few posts as a mixtape you made for your followers: a short tracklist, best first.
options.viewport: Left: today's tracklist (4 posts) with length and platforms. Centre: the live feed preview of the playing track. Right: copy and post.
options.risk: Turns into a nostalgia costume if the tape motifs leak past type, colour and the one move.

raised.raise: One colour, felt-tip red, is reserved for the post to make now; nothing else uses it.
Every post carries a track number in strict order, best first; the tracklist is the only map.
Tracklist columns never move: number, title, format, length, platforms; only their contents change.
Each product owns one tape colour, used on its spine and nowhere else.

options.label: Contact sheet
options.lineage: photographers' contact sheets marked with a grease pencil
options.thesis: Every idea printed as a frame; the best few are circled in grease pencil, the rest crossed out.
options.viewport: A strip of 8 frames for today; 3 circled picks lead, each opening into its feed preview and copy.
options.risk: Dark ground with one red accent is a look many tools already wear; must earn it with the marking gesture.

options.label: Metro tiles
options.lineage: Metro design language, flat tiles and giant lowercase
options.thesis: Today's posts as big flat colour tiles; type is the interface.
options.viewport: Giant lowercase 'today' cropped off the edge; 4 post tiles, the chosen one floods with the accent.
options.case: Bold colour fits the Arc and Raycast brief and reads clearly; founders do not see themselves in it.
options.risk: Can read as a dated phone UI if the type is not huge and the grid strict.

options.label: Streaming wall
options.thesis: Your products as rows, today's posts as artwork you browse and pick.
options.viewport: Top row: today's picks for Passalong as big artwork; rows below for other products.
options.case: Everyone knows how to use it; it shows volume, which works against 'today's best few'.
options.risk: Pushes towards browsing many posts, not posting the best one in five minutes.

options.label: Split-flap board
options.thesis: Posts as departures on a flipping board.
options.viewport: A board of today's posts by time.
options.case: Founders don't schedule departures; posts are not timetabled here.
options.kept: Fixed columns that never move; only their contents change.
options.risk: Implies scheduling, which the product refuses.

options.label: Factory catalog sleeve
options.thesis: Every post a numbered catalog artifact on matte black.
options.viewport: A fac number per post on vast black.
options.case: Cold and coded; the brief asks for playful and bold.
options.kept: Every artifact numbered in strict sequence; the index is the only map.

options.label: Orienteering map
options.thesis: A course of posts to run through, leg by leg.
options.viewport: Posts as numbered controls on a map.
options.case: No link between founders and orienteering; obscures the task.
options.kept: One colour reserved for the active leg only.

options.label: Transit diagram
options.thesis: Each product a coloured line, posts as stations.
options.viewport: Product lines meeting at today's interchange.
options.case: Pretty, but posts are not a route.
options.kept: One colour per product line, used consistently.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: A clean post editor with a realistic feed preview, like Typefully, done impeccably.
canonCard.viewport: Post list on the left, editor and feed preview on the right.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from the competition by design.
